title: Verification code for "Mixed Triple Metric Dimension of Polyhedral Graphs: Local Forcing and Extremal Families"
description: Computational verification accompanying the paper "Mixed Triple Metric Dimension of Polyhedral Graphs: Local Forcing and Extremal Families". Eighteen independent checks over prisms, antiprisms, stacked prisms, bipyramids and the icosahedron, reproducing every row of Table 2 of the paper. Core Perl, no external dependencies, exact integer arithmetic throughout.
